review:
Classic sevens with Hacksaw's cascade treatment. Land a Lightning symbol with a win and the Cascade Counter switches on: every removed non-winning symbol adds to a multiplier, and the final win gets multiplied once the cascades finish. Epic Lightning adds another multiplier on top.

Three FS give 10 spins with more Lightning, four give 10 with Lightning every spin, five unlock the top bonus. Hacksaw doesn't publish RTP, volatility or max win outside the game. Old-school symbols, modern maths.
